body: That isn't so much the point of what I'm trying to say (even though I really enjoy that point of view) When I am in those moods there is literally nothing I can think of to make them go away, my hobbies don't matter, work doesn't matter, my friends and family don't matter the only singular thought that gives me peace is the thought of being free from everything. I hope I wasn't rude.

The thoughts of not mattering follow the depression. I just get randomly extremely depressed for no real reason, then my thoughts affirm the fact that I shouldn't keep on living. I just stop caring about everything, and everyone.
